lessons: In chupa/triage.py, if message.reopen is true, no tombstone verdict may reach _record with record_id tombstone-{message.id}, whatever link it names. Route all of them to author so the committed tombstones/tombstone-{id} bytes stay unchanged, as the ticket's reopen invariant requires.

Do not depend on the _commit_record effect key ticket-plane/decisions/tombstone-{id} to protect a reopened item. That effect already completed, so it replays as a no-op and leaves an uncommitted, diverged registry file in the working tree.

Extend test_reopened_message_bypasses_its_tombstone: script a triage reply that tombstones a reopened message to a different committed link (for example the original target). Assert the tombstone record bytes and HEAD are unchanged and the Box item does not resolve back to a tombstone.

Once the fix is in, check that RereportJournal.record orders arrivals against the reopen and not a stale tombstone completion. Keep fresh semantic dedup and existing-record recovery bypassing the reopened target's old tombstone, as the ticket's Scope requires.
Change only triage.py and its tests. The review found no other problem, and all 2823 tests passed. Rerun every Verification command after the fix.
